subject: NorthStar Bank RFP — technical clarifications on resilience and audit evidence
messages:
From: Alice Turner <alice.turner@northstarbank.com>
To: alex.martinez@redwood.ai
Cc: northstar-procurement@northstarbank.com, ben.wilcox@northstarbank.com
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFP section 4.2 — resilience / audit evidence clarifications

Alex — thanks for the proposal and the redlined RFP. A few technical clarifications from our audit team to confirm before we move to the next stage: 

1) Recovery objectives: your RFP response lists an RTO "up to 6 hours" for hosted API fallbacks and an RTO "< 1 hour" for Dedicated. Can you confirm how RTOs are measured (per-route or per-deployment) and whether customers can contract a stricter RTO for hosted?

2) Evidence for auditors: we need a snapshot of controls that map to FFIEC/operational resilience items — SOC 2 report (latest), evidence of DR runbook (table of contents is OK), and an availability history for the last 12 months for our region (us-east-1).

3) Private deployment networking: the SOW asks about VPC peering, cross-account roles, and connectivity patterns. We need a short diagram or bullet list of the recommended topology for a VPC-based private control plane plus the data plane on customer-managed subnets.

4) Data retention and logs: auditors will want to know retention windows for request logs / audit trails, encryption-in-transit and at-rest details, and whether we provide immutable audit exports for a given retention period.

Can you provide clarifications and an ETA for evidence delivery (we'd like to review before vendor due diligence next week). If needed we can do a 30-minute screen-share with your security lead.

Thanks,
Alice Turner
Sr. Vendor Risk Manager — NorthStar Bank
alice.turner@northstarbank.com
(415) 555-0197
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Turner <alice.turner@northstarbank.com>
Cc: northstar-procurement@northstarbank.com, Ben Wilcox <ben.wilcox@northstarbank.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP section 4.2 — resilience / audit evidence clarifications

Alice — appreciated, quick answers below and attached a starter evidence pack for your audit team: 'soc2-snapshot-202606.pdf' and 'resilience-matrix-nsb.xlsx'. ETA notes at the bottom.

1) RTO measurement
- Dedicated: RTO is measured at the deployment pool level (reserved GPU capacity); typical observed recovery for failover to warm standby is < 1 hour (we define recovery as time to accept traffic and return to baseline token throughput for the same model/seq-length).
- Hosted: we publish per-route latency/availability SLOs; hosted fallbacks (to a compatible model variant or another region) yield an operational RTO of up to 6 hours in worst-case multi-region recovery.
- Contracting: Customers can contract stricter RTOs via Dedicated or an SLA addendum for Hosted (requires capacity reservation or burst capacity commitment).

2) Evidence
- Attached: SOC 2 snapshot (redacted), resilience matrix mapping RFP sections to control artifacts.
- DR runbook: we can provide a sanitized TOC and an extract of the incident playbook. Full runbook is available under NDA — we can schedule a secure transfer.
- Availability history: included as CSV in the resilience matrix (us-east-1, 12 months). If auditors need raw traces, we can arrange an exported report.

3) Private deployment networking
- Recommended topology (summary): customer VPC hosts data-plane subnets; Redwood control plane runs in customer-managed account (optional) or via a private peering/VPN. Cross-account IAM roles with least privilege and short-lived certs for node auth. We'll attach a simple diagram in the follow-up.

4) Logs & retention
- Request logs: default retention 90 days; optional extended retention to 7 years for enterprise customers (configurable).
- Audit exports: immutable daily exports delivered to customer S3 (or secure transfer) upon request; encryption at-rest using customer KMS keys is supported in Private deployments.

Action items / ETA
- I've attached the two files above.
- Internal approvals needed to share a redacted TOC and signed acknowledgement for evidence; I will loop in our security lead (Marissa) and product (Laura) for sign-off — can I share the SOC 2 snapshot and the DR TOC with NorthStar under the current NDA?
- If yes, we can deliver the signed evidence pack and the SLA-exception draft by Friday 24 Jul.

Happy to do the 30-min call — propose Thurs 23 Jul 10:00am PT.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai
Attachments: soc2-snapshot-202606.pdf (redacted), resilience-matrix-nsb.xlsx
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: NorthStar RFP — need sign-off to share SOC2 snapshot & DR TOC

Marissa / Laura — forwarding NorthStar's clarifications and my draft response (see attached). Two asks: 

1) Marissa — confirm we can share 'soc2-snapshot-202606.pdf' (redacted) and a TOC extract of the DR runbook under the NDA with NorthStar. Also confirm the RTO wording above (Dedicated <1h, Hosted up to 6h) is acceptable and whether we want to add an explicit note about failback testing cadence.

2) Laura — can you sign off on the proposed private deployment topology summary and approve handing over the resilience matrix CSV for availability history? Procurement may want the raw CSV.

I'll plan to schedule the 30-minute call with NorthStar once we have sign-off. Target: send final evidence and SLA-exception draft by EOD Fri 24 Jul.

Thanks,
Alex
(On behalf of NorthStar thread)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: alice.turner@northstarbank.com, ben.wilcox@northstarbank.com
Date: Sat, 24 Jul 2026 15:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: NorthStar RFP — need sign-off to share SOC2 snapshot & DR TOC

Alex / Laura — thanks. Approved to share the redacted SOC 2 snapshot and the DR runbook TOC under the current NDA. A couple of clarifications we should surface to NorthStar: 

- Failover testing cadence: we run scheduled failover exercises quarterly for Dedicated and semi-annually for Hosted; unscheduled DR drills are performed annually with post-mortem summaries available on request.
- Measurement definition: RTO (time to accept production traffic at baseline throughput) and RPO (maximum data window loss). We will include a short appendix in the TOC with definitions so auditors have the same interpretation.
- Availability data: the CSV in the resilience matrix is fine to share (redacted IPs). If they request per-route traces, require a data-sharing MOU.

Attached: 'signed-evidence-ack.pdf' — this is our internal signed acknowledgement that we will share the redacted artifacts for vendor due diligence, and 'sla-exception-draft.docx' — a short draft SLA exception for a contracted Hosted SLA if they want <6h RTO without Dedicated.

Alex — please send both attachments to NorthStar with a short covering email and propose the Thurs 23 Jul 10:00am PT call (if they still want it).

Marissa Cole
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Attachments: signed-evidence-ack.pdf, sla-exception-draft.docx
